messages.content: Help me with a partner integration.
Sure, working on a partner integration.
Here is the updated plan. Good news: the sandbox environment for partner testing made it in before the freeze. Idempotency keys on all write operations went smoothly in the end.
Good news: at-least-once webhook delivery with retries made it in before the freeze. Good news: consistent error envelopes with machine-readable codes made it in before the freeze.

Rewrote parts of sdk/python/client.py as well. The build is green. URL-based versioning over header negotiation is what we'll ship with. Don't let sunsetting v1 after the six-month window slip through the cracks.
Cursor pagination rather than offset beat the alternatives on every axis we care about. Nothing is blocking us right now.

What broke the release was cursor pagination skipping rows during concurrent writes. Webhook signature verification went smoothly in the end. A rate limit tier for enterprise keys is the obvious next step. Once CI passes I'll merge.

We can stop worrying about per-key rate limits with headers exposing the budget now. Rewrote parts of gateway/kong.yaml as well. Half the afternoon went to a 500 leaking a stack trace to API consumers.
Failed jobs are retried twice. What broke the release was rate limit headers reporting a stale budget.
